title: Guest baseline set
description: The defense baselines a guest can be given (ADR-0016, docs/compute-model.md). `controls` is the catalogue of generic, product-neutral defense controls, each in exactly one defense-in-depth layer, each with a human-readable `verify` observable and the Ansible `role` that implements it (null = no product chosen yet; the product is bound here and nowhere else). 1.1 adds `apply`: the role runs on every guest that needs the control (`guest`, the default) or once on the central product host named by `group`, which enrolls those guests (`central`, ADR-0016 decision 7). `baselines` are named sets of controls; a baseline may extend others. Lives as `_baselines.yml` next to the guest files; consumed by homelabnext.compute.

layer.description: The one defense-in-depth layer the control belongs to: identity (who can get in), host (the operating system itself), network (what traffic may flow), detection (seeing attacks and weaknesses), data (protecting what is stored), recovery (getting back after a loss).

role.description: The Ansible role that implements the control: with `apply: guest` applied to the control_<id> inventory group; with `apply: central` applied once to `group`, given the guests that need the control as <role>_guests. null = the product is not chosen yet; the baseline-playbook target lists it as unbound, never drops it.

apply.description: How the role reaches a guest (1.1, ADR-0016 decision 7). guest: it runs on every guest that needs the control (an endpoint agent). central: it runs once on the central product host (`group`) and enrolls every such guest there (a sensor's monitored addresses, a scanner's targets). `group` is required with central and refused with guest; that is a semantic rule (homelabnext.compute.baselines), so the schema stays additive.

group.description: With apply: central (1.1): the capability inventory group of the central product host, for example cap_sensor or cap_scanner (docs/role-interface.md section 5).

verify.description: How you would prove the control is in place on a guest (a human-readable observable).

extends.description: Baselines whose controls this one includes (resolved parents first).
